sentences.text:
Vikash Yadav @ Vikash Kumar Yadav vs The State Of
Jharkhand on 4 November, 2025

In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal NO(s). Of 2025
 (arising out of Slp (Crl.) No(s).14608 of
 2025)
 Vikash Yadav @
 Vikash Kumar Yadav Appellant(S)
 Versus
 The State Of Jharkhand Respondent(S)
 O R D E R

1. Leave granted.
2. The appellant challenges the impugned judgment and order dated 08.05.2025 in Reason: Crl. A.
@ S.L.P.(Crl) No.14608 of 2025 1 I.A. No.3016 of 2025 in Criminal Appeal (DB) No.1153 of 2018,
whereby
, the High Court had rejected the prayer to suspend the sentence and release the appellant on bail during the pendency of the appeal before the High Court.

The appeal before the High Court is against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 18.09.2018 and 22.09.2018 respectively, passed by the Trial Court in G.R. No.2388 of 2017, for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 506 of the IPC, 1860 and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (for Short, POCSO Act).

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Having heard the parties and after perusing the material available on record, we are inclined to suspend the sentence and enlarge the appellant on bail, for the reason that out of fifteen years of rigorous imprisonment imposed by the Trial Court, the appellant has already undergone more than eight years of incarceration, and thus as per law, he is entitled to such relief.
Ordered accordingly.

3.
